live_cases.name: get_info NVT OID filtering
live_cases.assertion: A typed NVT get_info list request with an oid=... filter returns exactly the selected NVT identity.

live_cases.name: empty-password live server rejection
live_cases.assertion: Supplementary typed-builder coverage rejects an empty password locally; a raw empty-password request to live gvmd then returns GvmError::Server status 400 with Authentication failed before same-connection get_version and valid authentication.

live_cases.name: get_settings invalid sort field
live_cases.assertion: A typed invalid sort field returns a normal GMP status 200 response through gvmd's validated fallback, and same-session get_version succeeds.

live_cases.name: note validation server errors
live_cases.assertion: Malformed severity and active values return GvmError::Server status 400 with Error in severity specification and Error in active specification respectively; raw XML is used only because these malformed values have no typed-builder representation, then same-session get_version succeeds.

socket_cases.name: empty-password authentication server error
socket_cases.assertion: Raw XmlCommand sends an empty password; GMP returns GvmError::Server status 400 with Authentication failed, then same-connection get_version and valid authentication succeed.

socket_cases.name: stop_task server error propagation
socket_cases.assertion: A deterministic Unix-socket script returns GvmError::Server status 400 with Internal error stopping task and proves same-session get_version remains usable.

excluded: The later stop-task return-code enum change is intentionally not covered.
